text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I arrived at a church to help out 
with an academy-sponsored photoshoot 
event.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a magnificent chapel! If only I 
could meet my prince in a place like 
this...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's all you ever think about. ...Well, 
I suppose the location itself isn't 
terrible.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, we're here to help today. We 
can't afford to let ourselves get 
distracted.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! I shall do my best so I am 
never caught unprepared should my prince 
appear!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Are you here to help as well, Trainer? I 
look forward to working with you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the event got underway, but—

text_block_list.name: Male Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
—This is gonna be a great shot! Come on, 
just strike one pose for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I already told you no, didn't I?! Put that 
camera down...!

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Come on, work with me here...! It has to 
be you as the model! Please!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my, I hear someone speaking with 
rather atrocious manners, don't I?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. That photographer seems to be 
completely disregarding the rules.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to step in. —Dober-san, I am 
coming to save you!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Eh? Kawakami-san!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*KABOOOOOOM!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...!! Th-There's a massive crater in 
the ground...!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—You there! If you harass Dober-san any 
further, I shall clobber you into 
oblivion!!

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!? Clobber me or not, my life is 
already in danger right now—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Silence yourself!! The punishment for 
distressing a maiden is severe!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If you still refuse to back down, then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*CRACK CRACK!*)

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Heeeeeek!! I-I'm sorry...!! Forgive 
meeeeeee~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by Kawakami Princess's 
powerful and righteous display, the 
photographer fled the scene in sheer 
panic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Kawakami. I... wasn't able 
to turn him down properly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, you did nothing wrong, 
Dober-san. I shall come rushing to your 
rescue anytime♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, shall we get back to work? All 
for the sake of meeting my dream prince!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A 'dream prince', huh... In your case, how 
you meet him doesn't really seem to 
matter, does it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...? Whatever do you mean?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? If you're that curious, why 
don't you ask the Trainer over there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching how Kawakami Princess had acted 
so far, what came to mind was—
choice_data_list:
I'm sure the prince will come to you 
instead.

There's a chance you might become the 
prince yourself.

There's a chance you might become the 
prince yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching how Kawakami Princess had acted 
so far, what came to mind was—
choice_data_list:
I'm sure the prince will come to you 
instead.

There's a chance you might become the 
prince yourself.

There's a chance you might become the 
prince yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that she possesses plenty of 
charms unique to her, and that drawn by 
those charms, the prince would surely come 
to her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, really...!? The prince, drawn to my 
charms...!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However, what exactly is my charm? Please 
tell me in detail, King-san!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh, what do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Come now, please let me hear it! Exactly 
what! Part of me! Do you find charming!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, I never went that far, did I!? Just 
ask the Trainer over there~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess, dreaming of the future. 
With her spirit, she will surely meet a 
wonderful prince someday.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...! I never even thought of that!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly imagine it, but a true 
princess must never remain ignorant.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I must by all means experience how a 
prince feels!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Which means, King-san, let us walk down 
the chapel aisle together!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want you to watch over my Princess 
Road—no, my Prince Road from the closest 
seat!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A-All right, fine! Just put away those 
fists of yours!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, someday the day will come where I 
walk side by side with my prince as a 
princess...♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, you still want to be the 
princess. Well, I suppose that suits you 
better anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess, dreaming of the future. 
With her spirit, she will surely meet a 
wonderful prince someday.
